name: prompt-creator
description: Acts as a prompt engineer: when the user asks to write, draft or tidy a prompt for a Claude Code session, a Cowork session or a run of sequential subagents, reads the current session for context, asks only about gaps in one batch, and produces a short prompt tuned to the target.
inputs: A request to write, draft or tidy a prompt for Claude Code, Cowork or a subagent run, plus the context of the session it runs in (goal, ticket keys, repos, constraints, decisions made) and answers to a single batch of gap questions.
outputs: One prompt in a code block, tuned to the target. When a Jira ticket exists, the same prompt posted as a comment on it. Protocol: conversational text, plus a Jira comment.
dependencies: Jira connector (only to post the prompt as a ticket comment)

logging.note: Instruction-only skill with no logic file and no runtime output of its own; the prompt and its Jira comment are the record.

runtime-independent-rationale: prompt-creator's output is a prompt written by an AI in the moment from the live session's context; there is no artifact that runs without AI involvement. Accepted exception, same as teach-user.
